one_liner: Netlify is a web hosting and continuous deployment platform for deploying and managing websites with automated builds.

auth.notes: OAuth 2.0 for public integrations; personal access tokens sent as Bearer tokens for API access

evidence.snippet: uses JSON for serialization and OAuth 2 for authentication
Use your PAT for manual authentication in shell scripts or commands that use the Netlify API

access.notes: Free tier available forever with self-serve signup; personal access tokens can be generated from account settings without approval

evidence.snippet: Free forever. Build and deploy free forever.

api_surface.rate_limit_note: 500 requests per minute for most endpoints; stricter limits on certain operations (3 deploys/min, 100/day)

buildability.rationale: Free tier with self-serve credentials, well-documented REST API with OpenAPI spec, webhooks support, and official MCP server already deployed.

overview_evidence.snippet: Netlify is a hosting service for the programmable web. It understands your documents and provides an API to handle atomic deploys of websites
